LanguageData.WotF_ManaWorkbench.description: A non-electric workshop built from a stone base, timber, and livingwood. Linked to a nearby mana network, it consumes mana only while a crafter is actively working and halts if the supply runs dry. Because it uses no electricity, elves retain their forest craft bonus here.
LanguageData.WotF_ManaWorkbench.label: mana workbench
